title: Multiple Linear Regression: Independent Variables & Prediction Models

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Let's have a quick look at multiple linear regression.
cues.zh: 快速看一下多元線性迴歸。

cues.en: So here's the equation for multiple linear regression.
cues.zh: 這是多元線性迴歸的方程式。

cues.en: As you can see, it's quite similar to the simple linear regression equation.
cues.zh: 可以看到，和簡單線性迴歸很相似。

cues.en: Here we've got the dependent variable, then we've got the y-intercept or the constant, then we've got a slope coefficient and independent variable, and then we've got more pairs of those,
cues.zh: 這是依變數，接著是 y 軸截距，也就是常數，再來是一個斜率係數與自變數，後面還有更多組。

cues.en: then we've got another slope coefficient and independent variable, and so on, and another slope coefficient and independent variable.
cues.zh: 接著又是一個斜率係數與自變數，依此類推。

cues.en: So basically, we have as many slope coefficients as we have independent variables.
cues.zh: 基本上，有多少個自變數，就有多少個斜率係數。

cues.en: Now, going back to our example of producing potatoes on a farm, we might want to predict how many potatoes we are yielding depending
cues.zh: 回到農場生產馬鈴薯的例子，可能要根據

cues.en: on how many kilograms of nitrogen fertilizer we're using, what the average temperature in the season is,
cues.zh: 氮肥使用公斤數、當季平均溫度，

cues.en: and how many millimeters of rainfall we've seen in the season.
cues.zh: 以及當季降雨毫米數，預測馬鈴薯產量。

cues.en: So the potatoes, in this case, the equation for potatoes would be, for example, eight tons would be a y-intercept, then three tons per kilogram
cues.zh: 例如，方程式的 y 軸截距是八公噸，而每公斤三公噸，

cues.en: would be the amount of fertilizer, the coefficient for fertilizer used.
cues.zh: 就是肥料使用量對應的係數。

cues.en: Then for average temperature in degree Celsius we might have a -0.54 tons per degree Celsius.
cues.zh: 平均攝氏溫度的係數，可能是每度 -0.54 公噸。

cues.en: And what that means is that the higher the temperature, the less potatoes will be yielded.
cues.zh: 代表溫度愈高，馬鈴薯產量愈少。

cues.en: And then for the rainfall, it might be 0.04 tons per millimeter.
cues.zh: 降雨量的係數，可能是每毫米 0.04 公噸。

cues.en: Now, to finish up, what I wanted to say is that we won't be using this example in our practical tutorials.
cues.zh: 最後提醒，實作教學不會使用這個例子。

cues.en: It'll be a different example.
cues.zh: 會換成其他例子。

cues.en: It'll be a fun and interesting example as well.
cues.zh: 同樣也很有趣。

cues.en: But if you wanted to learn more about potatoes and specifically the applications of multiple linear regression, here's a research paper that you might be interested in.
cues.zh: 但如果想多了解馬鈴薯，尤其是多元線性迴歸的應用，這篇研究論文可能值得一讀。

cues.en: It's called "The Application of Multiple Linear Regression and Artificial Neural Network Models for Yield Prediction of Very Early Potato Cultivators before Harvest."
cues.zh: 名稱是「運用多元線性迴歸與人工神經網路模型，在收成前預測極早熟馬鈴薯品種的產量」。

cues.en: So this paper combines multiple linear regression and neural networks.
cues.zh: 這篇論文同時使用多元線性迴歸與神經網路。

cues.en: It looks at two different ways of modeling them.
cues.zh: 比較兩種不同的建模方式。

cues.en: Of course, you can just focus on the multiple linear regression if you like.
cues.zh: 當然，也可以只看多元線性迴歸部分。

cues.en: It's quite an interesting read, and it can give you some additional deeper knowledge into the world of harvesting potatoes and multiple linear regression there.
cues.zh: 內容相當有趣，能更深入了解馬鈴薯收成，以及多元線性迴歸在這方面的應用。

cues.en: Other than that, enjoy the practical tutorials with Adlon, and I'll see you back here next time.
cues.zh: 接下來，享受與 Hadelin 的實作教學，我們下次見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
